intent_summary: Robust mode limits extreme observations' influence on trend fitting, residual calibration, and later seasonal references.

criteria.criterion: Robust seasonal references reduce the influence of an extreme prior matching seasonal value.
criteria.notes: Assertions check a independently computed weighted reference and invariance when an already-trimmed high value becomes more extreme.

criteria.criterion: Training and calibration diagnostics identify excluded extreme observations.
criteria.notes: Tests identify exact training/calibration exclusions and compare their influence on trend selection and residual scale.

criteria.criterion: An extreme evaluated sample remains evidence while its expected value is used in future references.
criteria.notes: The observed departure and trigger survive; only reference_values receives the prior expectation, preventing the next seasonal echo.

criteria.criterion: Callers can choose include mode to retain raw extreme observations and inspect the resulting echo behavior.
criteria.notes: CLI assertions distinguish robust triggers {65} from include-mode triggers {65, 72}.
